title: An angel with a sword over Jerusalem during the plague after David's census

tellings.quote: An angel stands [music] over Jerusalem with a drawn sword during the plague of David's census.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a Bible story: after King David ordered a count of his people, a plague struck, and an angel stood over Jerusalem holding a drawn sword. He raises it as an ancient account of a being appearing in the sky, which he places alongside modern encounter stories.
